title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_ulysse_by_james_joyce_2tbxz (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_ulysse_by_james_joyce_2tbxz' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, clean computer. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by its installation.
